items.name: Superior room
items.description:
Modern design in the spirit of colonial Asia. Check out the Superior room.

A basic standard room, although this does not mean lower quality. When staying in a Superior room, you can relax in a hot bath in the spacious tub, chill out in front of the 40” smart TV, and end the day in the softness of the King Size bed. The room offers the greatest possible comfort and premium quality materials as a matter of course.

rates.name: Best available rate - Bed and breakfast
rates.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at our hotel and start each day with a delicious breakfast. Book at our best available rate. Free cancellation is possible up to 1 day before arrival.
rates.cancellationPolicy:
Refundable rate: Your credit card is required as a guarantee only and will not be charged, provided that you cancel your reservation within the permitted cancellation period. The hotel must receive your cancellation notice at least 1 day before the scheduled arrival date. In case of late cancellation or no-show, a fee equal to 100% of the first night's stay will be charged.

Please note that the exchange rate applied by the hotel may differ from the exchange rate offered by your bank. Credit card payments will be charged in CZK. Any exchange rate differences are non-refundable.

items.name: Premier room
items.description:
A room designed to meet our guests' strictest requirements.

A level more comfort than the Superior room. More spacious and with a window in the bathroom. It makes relaxing in the designer bath with its dragon mosaic an even more magical ritual. All furnishings meet the strictest quality and aesthetic requirements. Your experience is enhanced by a view of Jakubská Street with its unique genius loci.

items.description:
Dharma ⁠⁠⁠-⁠⁠⁠ a word meaning the journey to an enlightened mind. You'll find peace and inspiration in the spacious living room of the Dharma corner suite.

The rain⁠⁠⁠-⁠⁠⁠effect shower will carry you off to a tropical rainforest. The widescreen smart TV opposite the large rosewood bed takes relaxation to another dimension. You can see the street lamps lighting the Basilica
of St. James from your corner bedroom.

items.name: Buddha Suite
items.description:
The best of the “Three Jewels” ⁠⁠⁠-⁠⁠⁠ the lavish design of the Buddha suite on the top floor of the hotel creates the illusion of a palace.

The attic rooms are connected to each other and provide the perfect place for inspiration and relaxation. While the Old Town offers unforgettable scenery outside the windows, your experience inside the suite is enhanced by the elements of fire, air and water. Which will draw your attention first ⁠⁠⁠-⁠⁠⁠ the fireplace, the deluxe attic light or the glazed passage into the bathroom?
